policy.functional_envelope_rule: every physical member is named by the H3-R2.1.2 instance UID; a branch envelope may own several parts only when the generated ownership list is complete

aon_common.basis: 6.0 TPS25751 + 5.8 two MSPM0 + 1.4 two LTC5532 + 15.0 ten indicators + 24.9735 exact-package logic/analog/supervisor maxima + 1.8265 named bias and pull branches
aon_common.source: official exact-MPN datasheets bound by H3-R2.0.2

aon_detector_one.basis: AD8314 maximum active current per enabled detector

hub_rp_peak.basis: 200-mA internal regulator maximum plus 50-mA I/O/flash admission

rf_rp_peak.basis: 200-mA internal regulator maximum plus 50-mA I/O/flash admission

display_idle.basis: display/touch logic and dim backlight admission

display_peak.basis: 80-mA display/touch admission plus exact 120-mA backlight maximum

storage_idle.basis: qualified medium unpowered or idle outside storage operation

audio_peak.basis: codec/selectors plus worst admitted 4-ohm speaker playback

main_common_idle.basis: complete generated member list; idle control, mux, expander and pull-network admission

main_common_peak.basis: complete generated member list; active control, mux, expander and simultaneously asserted user-input pull networks

nrf24_group.basis: three E01-ML01SP4 at 130 mA plus eight-mA exact interface/switch envelope

cc1101_group.basis: CC1101 maximum selected TX table plus both BGS13SN8 and local controls

voice_main_aux.basis: 3.3-V selectors, logic and audio-feed admission; PA current is on VVOICE

ir_group.basis: 50.6-mA corrected hot emitter corner plus both receivers and control logic

airband_chain.basis: receiver + 60.4-mA Si5351 maximum + 12-mA LT5560 maximum + 70-mA PGA-103 design admission + switches/bias

voice_pa.basis: one-hot selected SA818S-U or SA818S-V high-power TX maximum

external_port_electrical.basis: electrical port admission; U214 and M5 Unit paths are mutually exclusive

external_port_sustained.basis: 35-C ambient thermal admission; 1.25 A remains an electrical/transient ceiling

corrections.finding: the historical R1 calculator still described 3V3_MAIN as a 6-A rail although R2 fits TPS564252DRLR
corrections.correction: R2 uses the exact 4.000-A converter minimum as the limiting hardware capability
corrections.effect: the worst 3.046-A electrical corner still passes PF-R2-03, but only with 154 mA to the 3.200-A 25%-reserve boundary

corrections.finding: the 1.25-A exposed-port electrical ceiling was previously indistinguishable from a 24-to-48-hour thermal permission
corrections.correction: retain 1.25 A electrically and admit 1.00 A sustained at 35 C until H6/H8 closes the real layout/enclosure thermal path
corrections.effect: selected U214/U219/M5 functions remain available; unknown higher-current accessories are duty-limited rather than silently overheated

physical_residuals: H6 must realize converter/eFuse copper and vias at least as good as the modeled published EVM/package boundary
H8 must measure rail endpoints, current and temperature for each named sustained profile and reject any profile outside the generated envelope
H8 may raise the 1.00-A sustained external admission only after measured 35-C margin remains at least 20 C
